article.title: Effect of low-dose naltrexone for long COVID: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Byambasuren O, Atkins T, Baptista S
article.abstract: Long covid is a debilitating chronic condition, and the effect of low-dose naltrexone (LDN) on its symptoms is unclear. We aimed to determine the effectiveness of LDN on symptoms of long covid.
